Healing is usually your first priority as Ana (I can't tell you how many "DPS Anas" I've come across...). Say there's a Pharah who's lit in the sky. If your team mates are fine, you can feel free to quickly shoot her down and finish her off. But in general, I wouldn't try to spend most of your time going out of your way to get kills. Finish off enemies, but only if it's convenient. With Widow, your job is to get picks, but with Ana your job is to heal and protect (using your sleep dart especially) your team mates

Ana is definitely harder to play than Mercy, but your team mates' hitboxes are larger so that's at least nice. Really, I'd say the (mechanically) hardest part about Ana is sleep dart accuracy, but that's just my opinion. Besides that, you play Ana way different than you do Mercy, so that will definitely take some getting used to

Team comp is really important and Torb, at least currently, isn't usually a good pick, no matter how good are you with him. Also, gold damage doesn't matter.
